description: A grid of buttons combining up to seven gate sources onto six destinations, each destination carrying an OR of the sources switched into it

params.text: Lit, its row's source is included in the OR feeding that column's destination; unlit, that source is left out of it
GATES makes every destination follow its combined sources; TRIGGERS gives a 1ms pulse each time a combined result goes high

inputs.text: A gate source for the grid; the voltage counts as high once it passes 2V and stays high until it falls below 0.1V

outputs.text: Goes to 10V while any source switched into this column is high; with TRIGGERS chosen it gives a 1ms pulse at each rising edge instead

notes: anything patched into a source jack is treated as a gate before it is combined, so this is neither a switch nor a mixer
every button in the grid starts unlit, so nothing reaches a destination until a button is lit
